standard_prerequisites.name: The characterisation of surjectivity of a morphism of algebraic stacks through the surjectivity on points, and the criterion for decency through the quasi-compactness of a fibre product along a presentation
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 10473-10480) as pointers to results of the chapter on properties of stacks and of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the assertion to the quasi-compactness of a fibre product over a field valued point.

standard_prerequisites.name: The quasi-compactness of the morphism from a decent stack to a base along a field valued point, and the stability of quasi-compactness of a fibre product under such a point
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 10481-10489)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the two quasi-compact spaces whose fibre product computes the required one.

core_obligations: Every point arises over a field: by surjectivity every point of the target is the image of a morphism from the spectrum of a field into the source (proof lines 10473-10476)

Reduce to a fibre product: by the criterion for decency it suffices to show that the fibre product of an affine scheme over the target with the spectrum of the field along the chosen point is quasi-compact (proof lines 10477-10480)

Compute the fibre product: the proof rewrites that fibre product as the base change of the quasi-compact morphism from the source to the affine scheme along the chosen point, which is quasi-compact because the source is decent (proof lines 10481-10489)
proof_roadmap: 由 f 满，任取 y ∈ |Y| 有 x: Spec k → X 使 y = f∘x；由本章的判据，只需证 T ×_{Y,y} Spec k 准紧（T 仿射）。
有 (T ×_Y X) ×_{X,x} Spec k = T ×_{Y,y} Spec k；左边因 T ×_Y X → T 准紧而 T ×_Y X 准紧，又 x 因 X decent 而准紧，故该纤维积准紧。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that decency of an algebraic stack descends along a quasi-compact surjective morphism (author lemma at source lines 10465-10470, label lemma-qc-decent). The proof (source lines 10472-10490) uses surjectivity to write every point of the target as the image of a field valued point of the source, reduces by the criterion for decency to the quasi-compactness of a fibre product, and computes that fibre product as a base change of the (quasi-compact, by decency of the source) morphism from the source (proof lines 10473-10489). The reduction to the fibre product and its computation are the content. H2.
